attributes.title: 2027 Couples Therapy Conference
attributes.summary:
PESI's 2027 Couples Therapy Conference runs September 23 to 25, 2027, at the Westin Bonaventure in downtown Los Angeles and is streamed live online. The three days are devoted to couples work across therapy models, with live Q&A in most sessions.

PESI says CE credit is included with registration and that the program is designed for counselors, social workers, psychologists and marriage and family therapists, but the 2027 accreditation statements and hour totals were not published yet; its CE page lists the states where credit is only anticipated. Live attendees get credit only for workshops attended live, while the recording package offers self-study credit.

At the time we checked, the discounted in-person pass was $499.99 and the virtual pass $147.99, with a recording package available as an add-on.
